test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 18 April 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A can complete work in 25 days and B can complete the same work in 20 days. They started the work together but B left after 4 days and A continued to work. In how many days will the entire work be completed?
solution:
**Data given:**

Time in which A can complete the work = 25 days

Time in which B can complete the work = 20 days

Time for which B worked = 4 days

**Calculations:**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fc6881f8ec40361b929a1da98ea714a5880f1780a710a2f8324b1479d2946e98.png] **

Let us assume that the total work is 25 × 20 units i.e., 500 units

Portion of work done by A in 1 day = 20 units

Portion of work done by B in 1 day = 25 units

Total work done by A and B in 4 days = (20 + 25) × 4 = 180 units

Total work remaining = 500 – 180 = 320 units

Time taken by A to complete the remaining units = 320 ÷ 20 = 16 days

Total time taken to complete the entire work = 16 + 4 = 20 days

**The entire work was completed in 20 days.**
